provenance_note: Game results and closing lines are the nflverse parse of the NFL's GSIS feed; nfl.com is the official entry point and the 2026 results in this repository were checked against it.

method.ratings: Ridge regression on recency-weighted team attack and defence terms, fitted separately for margin and total, refitted for every (season, week) block using only games that finished earlier.
method.nested_selection: The recency half-life is chosen on the newest 15% of the training games only, never on the games being scored.

lookahead_probe.interpretation: The two fits produce different predictions, so the walk-forward cut is real: future games cannot leak into a past block.

paired_error_test.metric: mean(|result - model line|) - mean(|result - market line|), per game
paired_error_test.reading: A positive difference means the market line was closer to the result.

incremental_test.fit: actual home margin ~ 1 + market closing line + model line
incremental_test.reading: A model weight indistinguishable from zero means the model's disagreement with the closing line carried no information in this sample; a weight with |t| > 2 means it did.

corr_model_line_vs_result.method: Pearson r, Fisher-z 95% CI, two-sided t test

corr_market_line_vs_result.method: Pearson r, Fisher-z 95% CI, two-sided t test

corr_model_minus_market_vs_result_minus_.method: Pearson r, Fisher-z 95% CI, two-sided t test

current_board.note: The model spread is the points the HOME team is projected to win by; a negative number means the away team is projected to win. Where the market column is blank the source carries no line yet, and no line is inferred.
